meta.name: Sampurna
meta.description: Does marriage mean the end of a woman's rights over her own body? As Sampurna raises her voice against the abuse Nandini's husband inflicts on the latter, her family and the law of society turn out to be the biggest obstacles in her quest for justice.

videos.title: Utsaber Sheshey
videos.overview: Sampurna manages to get Nandini and Raktim married after a few hiccups. On Nandini's first night in her new home, Sampurna is surprised to see a dishevelled Nandini on the terrace.

videos.title: Swapnobhongo
videos.overview: Raktim and Nandini go on their honeymoon, but Nandini goes missing from their hotel room in the middle of the night. On their return, Sampurna is shocked to see the signs of abuse on Nandini's body.

videos.title: Bawjropat
videos.overview: Sampurna's family refuses to address Raktim's abusive behaviour. And when things seem to have gained the semblance of normalcy, the news of  Nandini's accident shocks everyone.

videos.title: Sanghat
videos.overview: Sampurna tells her family about Raktim's deeds but to no avail. She motivates the injured Nandini to speak her truth.

videos.title: Nirbashita
videos.overview: Sampurna's family pressurises Nandini to withdraw her statement. Sampurna's husband gives her an ultimatum.

videos.title: Juddho Shuru
videos.overview: Sampurna reveals Raktim's true colours to Nandini. And this is where Sampurna and Nandini's real quest for justice begins.
